title: ConstructContext
description:
Multi-cistron construct layout and regulatory metadata (BRIEF-2.2-c).

WHY THIS IS A FIRST-CLASS SCHEMA RATHER THAN A FASTA HEADER. The systems-level joint search optimizes several CDSs against one shared resource ledger, so it needs to know which CDSs share a cell, what their expected relative expression is, and which of them the user actually cares about. None of that survives a FASTA round-trip. It is also what lets the k-mer/repeat constraints be evaluated over the WHOLE construct - including the immutable backbone - which is exactly what the existing `codon_6.0.py` prototype does by masking CDSs out of the insert before counting.

ELEMENT SPANS ARE NUCLEOTIDE-BASED; everything downstream of ingest is codon-based. The conversion happens once, at ingest, and is the only place in the system where a frame error is possible.

topology.description: Circular topology matters for repeat counting: a k-mer spanning the origin is a real repeat in the physical plasmid.

full_sequence.description: The complete construct as assembled, including backbone. Element spans index into this string.

copy_number.description: Plasmid copies per cell. Multiplies every cistron's demand in the resource ledger; a high-copy vector is often the dominant burden term.

elements.description: Ordered annotation of the construct. Non-CDS elements are immutable but still participate in structure, repeat and motif objectives.

editable.description: Only CDS elements may be editable, and only by synonymous substitution.

spacer_length_nt.description: For RBS elements: distance from Shine-Dalgarno to start codon. Enters the initiation-region structure constraint.

cistrons.description: Translational units. The joint search allocates one resource-ledger contribution per cistron.

is_design_target.description: False for cistrons that are present and consume resources but must not be redesigned (e.g. a fixed selection marker).

expected_relative_expression.description: Prior on this cistron's protein output relative to the others in the construct, on any consistent scale. Drives the demand weighting f_k in the resource ledger. Defaults to equal weighting with an explicit uncertainty flag.

priority_weight.description: How much the user cares about this cistron's own objectives when they conflict with another's. Used only in the joint-search scalarization tie-break, never inside the Pareto comparison.

operon_group.description: Cistrons in one operon share a transcript, so a structure change in one can affect a neighbour's initiation.

assembly.description: Assembly method. This is what auto-populates the forbidden restriction-site constraint set, mirroring `auto_detect_forbidden_motifs` in the existing prototype but driven by declared intent rather than by inference from the input sequence.

vendor_profile.description: Selects vendor synthesis-complexity limits (GC windows, repeat length, homopolymer runs).
